# @sharadox/scroll-web-library

> Smooth scrolling (Lenis) and active-section tracking for React.

- /smooth-scroll: <SmoothScroll duration=1.15 anchorOffset=-60 /> — off with prefers-reduced-motion; handles a[href^="#"] clicks
- /active-section: useActiveSection(ids: readonly string[]) → { active: id at viewport middle, within: 0–1 through it, page: 0–1 page progress }
- Peer: react. License: Sharadox Open Source License 0.1.0
